correctness.rationale: For n>=2, the zero-sum l1-section is exactly conv of all signed complete-graph roots. An n-1 dimensional sector coarea calculation gives the sector volume sqrt(n)/[(n-1)(k-1)!(n-k-1)!] and Dirichlet conditional moments; two explicit Vandermonde identities give intrinsic radial second moment 4(n-1)(2n-1)/[n(n+1)^2]. Permutation invariance forces covariance scalar 4(2n-1)/[n(n+1)^2]. Substituting volume and regular-crosspolytope formulas gives the stated rational-power ratio. Exact n=3,4, gamma log-convexity plus monotonicity and pi<22/7 prove strictness n>=5. Stirling gives the sharp first-order constant. A standalone checker recomputes exact simplex volumes and moments n=3..6 and finite exact identities and inequalities n=3..200. Finite checks are auxiliary, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The full complete-graph type-A root polytope is a canonical infinite family with nontrivial mixed-sign geometry. Its exact continuous-volume inertia and affine-invariant isotropic constant are meaningful and are not implied by discrete face/volume counts. The comparison strictly separates it from the natural regular-crosspolytope benchmark in every dimension n>=3 and resolves the sharp first-order approach to equality, a quantitative geometric distinction with an exact one-dimensional boundary case.
